vision.name: Blue Unity Mastery
vision.text:
[Instant] POWER: Use after performing a successful Styled attack. That attack gains "HIT: If you control 2 or less Allies, search your Life Deck for a non-[Continuous] Ally and play it."
POWER: Choose an Ally you control. That Ally can make actions regardless of your MP's power stage this combat. Your opponent skips their next action this combat.
